subject: Jerin achievement
text: The Jerin achievement triggered when Jerin was first saved, not when she joined the party.

evidence.quote: the Jerin achievement was triggered when I saved her the first time, not when she joins the party.

subject: Achievement trigger reports
text: One player reported 5 achievements did not trigger after finishing the game: Jerin, Level 25, Phantasm, Amon's Follower and Darkness.

evidence.quote: Finished the game, but 5 achievements didnt trigger (got all others...)- Jerin, Level 25, Phantasm, Amon's Follower and Darkness

subject: Might Bow and Might Shield
object: not using wishes to obtain them
text: The Might Bow and Might Shield are missable if the player does not use wishes to get them.

evidence.quote: The might bow and shield are also missable if you don't use your wishes to get them.

subject: Might Shield
text: Wishing for 3 Might Shields can lock the player out of the Might Bow.

evidence.quote: It's possible to wish for 3 shields and lock yourself out of the bow.

subject: New achievements
text: New cheevos can be obtained in Try Again Mode.

evidence.quote: Can I get the new cheevos in Try Again Mode?
@Madawk You absolutely can.  That's how I got mine.

subject: Dragon Wishes
text: The revised set requires exhausting the Dragon Wishes, where the old set required only one wish.

evidence.quote: The new additions allow you to do a bit more in the game compared to the old set, such as properly exhausting the Dragon Wishes where the old set only required one wish, and collect the strongest gear in the game for achievements.

subject: Might set
text: The full Might set can easily be missed in a casual playthrough.

evidence.quote: The full Might set is easily missable in a casual playthrough.

subject: Might Helmet
text: The Might Helmet can be missed, according to a GameFAQs topic.

evidence.quote: According to a GameFAQs topic, you could miss something called the 'might helmet', but I don't see an achievement for that?

subject: Treasure chest
text: Dragon Eggs can replace the original chest contents if the chest is not opened first.

evidence.quote: Dragon eggs can replace the original chest contents if not opened prior.

subject: Black Market
text: The Black Market achievement can be obtained by visiting its location, with no first-time visit required.

evidence.quote: Black Market can be obtained by visiting the location since that doesn't require a first time visit, but that's it.

subject: End-game save
text: A save made after finishing everything before the revision cannot unlock the new achievements without redoing them.

evidence.quote: An end game save that has done all of this won't be able to unlock the new achievements without doing it again.

subject: Jerin achievement
text: Players registered on the Discord can submit a manual unlock request if the Jerin achievement stays locked.

evidence.quote: If you are registered for the discord, you should be able to submit a manual unlock request.

subject: Jerin achievement
text: A manual unlock request may ask for a save, but a save is likely unnecessary since later progression achievements exist.

evidence.quote: They might ask for a save but since it's a progression achievement and you have other progression achievements after it. You likely won't even need to.

subject: Jerin achievement
text: One player saw the Jerin unlock icon, but the achievement stayed blocked on the website.

evidence.quote: The achievement unlocked icon appeared and I continued with my save, but when I accessed the website it remained blocked.

subject: Battle attacks
text: Attacks are not redirected to another target when an enemy is defeated, which slows battles.

evidence.quote: In the fights the attacks are not redirected when an enemy is defeated, that sometimes annoys and slows down the speed of the fights a bit, also the ABSURD amount of enemies that appear almost at every step you take.

subject: Random encounters
text: Random encounters are frequent, and healing is needed after every battle.

evidence.quote: Not a terrible RPG on its face, but by the time you are done you -will- be absolutely sick of random encounters and healing up after every single one.

subject: Rare drops
text: Grinding was only needed for rare drops, and the reviewer was over level 50 (Lv78) by the end.

evidence.quote: The cheevo set itself is fair, the only grinding I really had to do was for the rare drops (and by the time I was done, I was -way- over level 50, Lv78 hero)

subject: Smoke Bombs and Sweet Water
text: Smoke Bombs and Sweet Water are available from the beginning and help with the encounter rate.

evidence.quote: Regarding the encounter rate, right from the beginning you get access to two of the best items in the whole game: Smoke Bombs and Sweet Water.

subject: Sweet Water
text: Sweet Water sharply reduces the encounter rate.

evidence.quote: The water drops the encounter rate dramatically, and the few encounters I got while having its effect, just used a Smoke Bomb.

subject: Spell and item names
text: Spell and item names are misleading, so a list with their descriptions is recommended.

evidence.quote: Also, for those planning on getting into the game, do yourself a favor and get a list of all spells / items with their descriptions. Most of the names (especially of spells) are so misleading!

subject: Patch
text: The patch corrected the names and descriptions of items and spells.

evidence.quote: The patch also corrected the names and descriptions for better explanations and uses.

subject: Foul Waters
text: Foul Waters should not be wasted if the Might Sword is not obtained early, since they help with grinding.

evidence.quote: I have no tips to give besides do not waste Foul Waters if you don't get the might sword early... it's gonna help a lot with grinds.

subject: Might item achievements
text: The Might item achievements depend on RNG and can take hours or minutes of grinding.

evidence.quote: This set is good, no crazy shenanigans, just some crazy grinding for the Might stuff (which can go for hours or minutes, depending on your relationship with our lord and saviour RNGesus).

subject: World map
text: An online world map is recommended as a help.

evidence.quote: Also online world map helps.

subject: Difficulty curve
text: Early difficulty is uneven, but with enough tools and a handy flute, the game becomes easier, especially the final bosses.

evidence.quote: the difficulty curve was all over the place in the beginning but with enough tools and a very handy flute Stuff became a lot more trivial, especially the final bosses.

subject: Some RNG achievements
text: A couple of RNG achievements can take minutes to hours, with one player grinding for six hours.

evidence.quote: The achievement set is very straightforward and fair, with the exception of a couple RNG related achievements that can take minutes to hours to obtain (six hours of grinding for me!).

subject: Text guide or maps
text: A text guide or maps are highly recommended for this game.

evidence.quote: I'd highly recommend either following a text guide or using maps to get through this one.

subject: Encounter rate
text: Encounter rates make every map a chore to explore.

evidence.quote: But man, the combat is dull and the encounter rates made every map a chore to explore.

subject: Might Sword
text: The Might Sword drop is RNG-based and took one player a couple of days to appear.

evidence.quote: The set was also great with one exception, the Might Sword drop RNG. Took me a couple days before it dropped.

subject: Only missable
text: A player accidentally completed the game's only missable while playing blind.

evidence.quote: Masterizei jogando blind e tive um pouco de sorte de ter feito o único missable sem querer.
evidence.translation: I mastered it playing blind and was a bit lucky to have done the only missable without meaning to.

subject: Encounters
text: Excessive encounters are the main annoyance, but not avoiding them makes the other achievements, including item-drop ones, easy.

evidence.quote: Única coisa realmente chata no jogo é o excesso de encounters, mas se você não evitar eles (que nem eu fiz por 99% do jogo) vai acabar fazendo os outros achievements facilmente, incluindo os de drop de item.
evidence.translation: The only really annoying thing in the game is the excess of encounters, but if you don't avoid them (like I did for 99% of the game) you will easily do the other achievements, including the item-drop ones.

subject: Might Helmet
text: Getting the Might Helmet in the tower requires avoiding certain triggers, which took research to learn.

evidence.quote: Grinding for the might sword/shield was a bit rough (took me around an hour) and getting the might helmet in the tower took some reading up on what triggers you have to avoid.

subject: Might Sword and Might Shield
text: Grinding for the Might Sword or Shield took one player around an hour.

evidence.quote: Grinding for the might sword/shield was a bit rough (took me around an hour) and getting the might helmet in the tower took some reading up on what triggers you have to avoid.

subject: Dragon Eggs
text: Dragon Eggs are described as the only true sidequest in the game.

evidence.quote: the dragon eggs I suppose but that's also the only true sidequest in this game.

subject: Some item drops
text: Some items drop at a 1/256 rate and require grinding.

evidence.quote: Also, devs who force players to seat through mindless grinds for 1/256 items are definitely not high in my book.

subject: Encounter rate
text: The encounter rate is extremely high, especially when played on fast forward.

evidence.quote: I would say though the encounter rate is extremely high, especially if played on fast forward.

subject: Old Cave
text: Players can push the Old Cave early and hunt Dragon Eggs as optional content.

evidence.quote: I enjoyed Lufia & the Fortress of Doom, especially exploring optional content, pushing the Old Cave early, hunting the Dragon Eggs, and completing the achievements.

subject: Status effects
text: Status effects are more useful in combat than expected.

evidence.quote: The combat also surprised me, with status effects being much more useful than I expected.
